summary: Fractal web CI detects the generated TypeScript client export graph and its compile inputs instead of Rust generator sources, client docs, or root flake-only changes. Committed fixtures now trigger web execution. The generated workflow embeds the same detector, with tests guarding consumed and excluded paths.

replay.detail: CI scheduling only; no replay or rebuild of runtime state.

schema.detail: No database, claim, browser-state, or wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, protocol, harness, or CLI change. Rust and schema-source-only changes do not schedule web lanes; changed consumed generated TypeScript, build inputs, and fixtures still do.

downtime.detail: No deployed service change or interruption.

manual.detail: No installation or operator action required.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery change; malformed detection inputs and failed Git operations still fail closed.
